title: DF1 lead-carried seal ageing
hypothesis: Because DF1 sealing rings remain with the implanted lead across generator changes whereas DF4 inter-contact seals reside in the generator header, very late connector-interface failure phenotypes may diverge as DF1 lead seals age and DF4 header seals are periodically renewed.
primary_outcome: connector-interface failure phenotype; ingress; intermittent contact; noise; impedance abnormality; inability to connect/reuse lead
required_stratifiers: implant age; generator-change count; manufacturer; lead family; exact connector model
notes: Mechanically plausible, not a demonstrated clinical effect. MAUDE alone cannot supply incidence.

title: DF4 terminal polymer ageing
hypothesis: Different DF4 terminal-body/inter-contact or seal-zone polymers may develop different late mechanical or electrical failure phenotypes after >10 years in vivo.
primary_outcome: terminal cracking/deformation; cross-contact leakage; contamination; intermittent noise; high/low impedance; connection failure
required_stratifiers: implant age; polymer; manufacturer; connector generation; lead family; generator header family
notes: Current sourced seed: Biotronik Protego PEEK 450G; Medtronic Sprint Quattro 6935M sealing zone PEEK; Boston ENDOTAK RELIANCE 4-Site terminal molding polyurethane 75D. Abbott production material remains unresolved; a contemporaneous Pacesetter patent lists Tecothane/PEEK/polysulfone as alternatives and is not product-specific.

title: DF4 late-age divergence
hypothesis: Any material- or architecture-related connector signal may be weak early and become visible only in the oldest DF4 cohorts.
notes: Earliest US DF4 families now provide meaningful 12+ year exposure. Use event-age distributions before attempting rate claims.

title: Matched-lineage analysis
hypothesis: DF1-vs-DF4 comparisons should preferentially use families where the connector/transition is the principal design change; heavily modified successor leads should be analysed separately.
required_stratifiers: manufacturer; family; non-connector design deltas; implant era
notes: Biotronik Linoxsmart→Protego is strongest seed match. Medtronic 6947→6947M is also unusually clean in FDA review. Boston RELIANCE→4-Site is explicitly confounded by additional cable/tubing/suture-sleeve changes.
